text: Huge download, not entirely like the ads suggest, you get the + and - and the barrels but the game is a cakewalk, and the levels end in 30 seconds. Any sense of progression and good choices is quickly over. It's so superficial and not engaging, or rewarding, and leads too heavily into the base building element where they clearly put all their budget and wasted potential not realising that all we wanted was the game from the ads but longer. Wanna make money? Make the game in the ads. Ridiculous.

This is 95% tower defense multiplayer game. Build, and harvest resources, with a fairly set progression path (no thinking). It is a Clash of Clans type game for 95% of the time. Fun to start with with quite a bit of the add type gameplay then it's a grind and mainly building and harvesting. I sank a lot of hours into this and would give it 3 stars if the adds weren't misleading. TO THE DEVELOPER. Why don't you show the main part of the game in Your ads? Do you think it's not good enough?

Some zombies, mostly slow base building and getting destroyed by other players. If you want what you see in the ads, you'll be disappointed. If you want a game that's player vs player (read higher level player destroying lower level players), and slow at building levels (unless you pay regularly), then this is the game for you. I put a fair bit of time into it (no money), but gave up when there was a server vs server battle that saw my efforts obliterated by two much higher level players.

It's a falsely advertised, very boring, base building game. You'll rush up to lvl 5 and then it's just a slow grind from then on in, waiting for your structures to be built so you can upgrade the HQ, in order to progress further in the game and actually be able to do what the adverts, show you you can do. Or you can waste your money on the usual loot boxes etc.

Almost an enjoyable game... Aside from the body of the game being nothing like the advert, there are bugs that prevent progress. There is no in game support, so I emailed the dev directly, no response, so I assume they only care about the in game transactions (of which there are very many!) - this is a pay to win game, there are better examples out there - one word summary - avoid!

False advertising. The game is supposed to be just like the ad when it fact it's not. The game is stupidly expensive. Pay to win, pay to progress (or waste time grinding and getting nowhere). I can't progress as my heros arent strong enough, don't have enough resources to upgrade skills, equipment, building and not enough stamina. Eventually, if you want to continue, you're going to have spent money to keep up with players as grinding the game without spending money will be a waste of time.

Good game, but be careful. The game will try and entice you to pay £1.99 for what it suggests, "permanently unlocking a building que" you can only build one item at a time. But after paying your money, like I did, it then only unlocked one more build, so two at a time. If you want more, it's then £9.99 and goes up from there. A total scam tactic. Same for unlocking new players, they show a new player with high attacking rates, but starts off low level. Don't spend a penny on this game....

One of the most predatory games in terms of micro transactions that I have played, if you don't want to spend money then progress is extremely long winded and beyond frustrating. There's literally a daily task to buy something from them. I would avoid in future. There are some neat ideas here and the gameplay is initially fun, but it won't last, not unless you want to empty your bank account to progress

All I hear is.. Running out of time, soldier, move quickly.. but you end up doing the same missions over and over anyway. After a while, it feels less like surviving and more like grinding. The pressure never lets up, but the fun definitely does. It’s repetitive, tiring, and kind of misses the point of what a good survival game should be.

Pretty, but that's about it. In their ads, they boast about how the game is supposed to be focused on the fun arcade style of gameplay, but that's maybe 10% of it. The rest is a shameless Clash of Clans rip-off, and you'll be spending the majority of the game grinding your base and avoiding paying for everything. Even the arcade elements are very inconsistent. They're obviously rigged, little grouped soldiers sometimes conveniently "forget" to fire. Has some performance issues as well.

So, installed it, played for a few days, even spent some money in it, when I decided for the account deletion, after i confirmed says the server is on maintenance, keep in mind this was 3 days ago, uninstalled it, installed again, same thing, good job guys, good job, how clever is this? For me just seems as if you don't like when someone decides to leave, no longer able to verify if the account deletion is in progress or not, well it is what it is, thanks for nothing. I will not contact you!!!

Every ad I get on all my apps is an ad for this game, telling me it's "not fake". After about a week of being bombarded with these ads, I finally caved and downloaded the game, and... it won't connect to the server 👎. The developers will happily spend an extortionate amount of money on marketing, but can't get the game to work. Nice one 👌

Even the ads are saying the gameplay is as advertised. Nope, it's a base builder. Repsonse. I would say some of the minigames are styled like your ads. You show zero gameplay in your ads. I did try your game, it's a time-sink click fest. I would say false advertising, no where do you suggest there are any base building, not one word or picture. Get your ads company to make a game, looks like they could do a good job.

As a resource collecting/base building game, it's actually quite good. However if you play for free, then EVERY weekend you will be curbstomped by players who throw $100s at this game that you will never stand a chance against no matter how much you level up your stuff. So your base and your entire army that took 2 whole days to train just get wiped out instantly and there's nothing you can do about it. Total waste of time.

Good game if you're ready to spend in the hundreds of £ at the very least. There are some whales in the game that spend daily £100 and are far ahead of the others. If you get to be in one of the top alliances, you'll enjoy playing along with your team. Otherwise it's stressful and constantly getting you in the need to put real money into it. An example is the £5 daily so called must buy packs. Not mandatory almost needed to keep up the pace.

Some of it was fun, but it's not what you advertise, is it? There are the elements of what you feature in ads , but it's either designed to draw people in falsely, or gameplay I thought looked fun is so late in the game that I'd never see it. It's prob also behind paywall features so vast that they make the known universe look small. Not wading through all that. Gave a 2 because I suspect you could make a fun game, but it's vastly overshadowed by the hope to cream people of all their dosh.

I absolutely hate this game. Not for the gameplay, but for the ads - there are SO MANY ads for this game and they all have someone, pretending to play the game, going "Woah, hey, this game isn't like those fake ad games, this game plays exactly like the ads, woah!" Then you try the game and lo and behold, it's nothing like the ads. False advertisement to an excruciating level. To your average YouTube user, these ads are constant too. If you can make a game, at least be honest about it.

Forever doing updates that create more glitches. Don't pay to play, waste of money. I thought it was going to be more like the advert of chasing and killing zombies. It isn't, that's a very small part of the game. Just another base building game, join an alliance, bash other bases meanwhile you slowly fall behind because you don't know the tips and tricks to success. I've received a partial refund. Now unable to play because my account is in "credit" due to refund of not working. Rip off.

I enjoy playing this game, but after the first few levels it is absolutely nothing like the adverts you see on social media. Make no mistake, this is a pay to play game. If you can't or won't spend money on the game your growth will be very slow this leads to alliances refusing to let you join, which will slow your growth even further. The further through the game you go, the more it costs. It's a fun game, its an expensive game, it is nothing at all like the adverts you see on social media.

Couple of days of fun - nothing more. Had high hopes at first, seemed quite good with lots to do and without needing to pay to play. Fast forward a few days and things just take way too long - by far the worst part of the game is the "Operation" challenges whereby it shows you a YouTube video how to complete the level but the video does not play how the game does and you are always far too weak to bypass any levels after around 40. update: down to 1 star, the games a complete scam.

Just a way for devs to make money. Edit: Nothing has changed, it is still heavily biased towards those willing to spend a ton of money. The seasons are exactly the same. If you spend money you will challenge for the best equipment and cities. If not, you wont even make a dent. Suggestion: Too much content is cross server, meaning these players just come and take anything they want, stop this cross server nonsense. Don't bother installing unless you're prepared to pay a fortune.

It's advertised as a quick pick up & play shooting game but quickly turns into a very slow building game, which takes up ALL of your time. They've used misleading keywords to upgrade for real money & players have already spent over £1,000 to have an advantage over others, so if you're looking free to play or even enjoying the game on a budget, you'll soon become frustrated. As of Friday night, they force you to play a 24 hour mode against big spenders and you lose everything you've built

absolutely terrible and ain't no match as they did in advertisments. Its just a base builder game more than a shooting game u saw on the ad. Also, after a certain level you got to spend some money in order to play and win with other online players. Spend more money to Win in this game. really regret on downloading and played this game for a while. these korean and chinese servers who can spend 1000s of $$ will smash you down if you don't have ur troops stronger. Absolute no match for everyone.

it's an ok game, but I find it unfair and uneven that people that are so much more powerful than you are can repeatedly attack your base. You have to spend money to get to the level of the people constantly attacking your base. I feel it should be two levels above and below that can plunder/scout and attack. Most of my squads are level 40-60. being bombarded by level 90's is kinda making me want to delete the game.

What a useless game. After 1 year of playing, reaching level 30, I'm no more powerfull, in reality, than when I was level 10. You stand no chance in this game unless you're willing to spend thousands of $$$ in it. Also the advert is simply a lie. The shooting of zombies part, only makes up for one percent of the game. DON'T START PLAYING IT !!!

Devs will steal your money... incorrectly advertise in game purchases and won't refund you after a purchase despite it being falsely advertised. Despite providing proof they denied my refund. Google issued one and now they refuse to allow me to access my account when the fault is all theirs. Game has many many bugs and all the Devs care about if taking your money... buyer beware!!! When I first started playing the game looked nothing like the previews.... more false'vertising!

lmao I saw an ad for this where the guy was like "I promise you it's like the ads..." and yeah it kinda is for short sections but then you have to base build and the fights are locked behind base building progress which as others have mentioned is limited by an ever spiralling upwards amounts of time. I got to a point where it was going to take 2 hours before I could actually play the game again so deleted it. Also the UI is ungodly busy, 20 icons? lmao.

Extremely repetitive base building game with plenty of microtransactions and forced idle time. You have to wait for upgrades to be completed that increase exponentially in wait time, unless you fancy spending money every 5 seconds. The gameplay of the action segments are in fact slightly similar to the ads but get extremely tiresome after the first 10 missions. Lots of unavoidable traps and obstacles to ensure you don't get too far without doing all the upgrades. Do not recommend.

I've been playing last few months, it's not a bad game especially the early gameplay. But it gets old very quickly and you find yourself logging in to do the same things a couple of times a day. The worst part of the game (and what has made me uninstall) is the other people who play it. You're guided into groups however despite being within a group for months you then get booted out randomly with no notice when the server decides it's time to upgrade and reshuffle team. Ultimately got bored.

Considering the advertising campaign for this is "finally! A game just like the ads!" etc - it's not. It's another alliance-essential, base-building, resource management game with the shooter attached. Homelander lied - what a surprise. Uninstalled in less than 20 mins when it was no longer the fun little shooter it was advertised as.

You will soon realise all those YouTube adverts aren't real there is very little actual gameplay, what you get instead is to be a Base Manager, where you spend increasing amount of time to upgrade your base just to play a few rounds of the game before you are either locked out of it because you haven't upgraded your base enough or you can't defeat the enemy, rinse repeat over and over again. you can overcome that with copious amounts of money spent in game and that is obviously what they want.

First of all the advertisement is misleading, what gets advertised is just a minigame inside a completely different game. This must be the game with the most boring game mechanics I have played in my entire life. It's extremely addictive at first, until you realise there's absolutely no substance in it. Upgrades slow down to a crawl unless you pay, there is no skill whatsoever involved in the battle aspect, competitions are unbelievably P2W, it's just designed to extract money from your wallet.

Played this for a week and it is nothing like the ads. And that's even worse for a game that is supposed to be like the ads in their own advertising. The special ops mini game is 1-2% of it all and 30 sec long. The rest is base building. And that mini game is nothing like the ads, you deal millions of damage after a few days and smoke barrels with one hit. You don't need to move at all as heroes autoaim. False advertising. Devs are not trying to make it better for the players, only their pockets

The ad claims it's not like those other games where their ads are nothing like the game. This games ad claims it's the real deal, and yet when you get into the game, it's obviously not like the ad. It's similar sure, but it isn't the same game. Just use genuine gameplay for your ad, it's really quite simple. And get some decent actors for your ads whilst you're at it.

Very frustrating game. As others have said, progress is slow if you don't spend. Overnight you can have loads of progress wiped out. Not a massive amount of the gameplay from the advert available. Update: It really is absolutely stupid that you can have loads of progress wiped out while not even playing the game. Was giving it one last chance but giving up on it now.

Don't let the ads fool you; it's just another base building grind with microtransactions and "time savers." You don't even run through hordes like the ads show; you're completely stationary and fire at an abysmally slow pace, even with upgrades, so each level just feels like a chore. You're better off playing something else that actually involves you in the game

enjoying it early so far.... Edit well that ended quickly.... The game progresses normally... And then WHAM... It hits you with an impossible stage to pass... And the only way to move forward is grind for days (later stages weeks) just so that you can upgrade your purple heroes enough to pass. Or there's the HUGE PROPMT to buy a golden hero and easily pass... Absolute predatory practices... Do not play this game unless you want to pay loads... Some kid spent £200 in one day just on one hero

It's not the game that's advertised. It's a base builder, which I thought was fine until I realised other players attack you, by which point I had already put in time and (a little) money. There's no limit to who can attack you or how many times, right now it takes about 2 full days to fill my barracks and less than 10 minutes for somebody further in the game empty them and leave you waiting to fill your barracks back up. Plenty people in game chat complain as well.

This game is nothing like the ads. It is a click bait pay to play game. You have a base that you have to build however the base can be attacked by other players if you don't have a shield which of course you have to pay for and its expensive. The game was ok and reasonably fun to play until you get to level 50 then it is almost impossible to progress unless you pay for packs, unfortunately very very expensive. Not worth the time to install.

Quickly becomes base building grind, starts off quite good and fun, you can play lots of levels, and initially build base quickly. After just one week the game has deteriorated to 48 hours of base building in order to be able to gather enough resources to upgrade my troops so that I can have one battle before I need to go through the whole cycle.

If you think this game is about the scrolling, swipe battles,It isn't. It's a base building game with a diminishing number of those battles as you go through. Most battles require no user input as well, so the fun battles are the smallest part of the game mostly at the start. I played until level 18 before I got frustrated that the battle element was increasingly rare. Micro transactions aren't so micro either. You could buy many full price AAA games with the money you'd spend to avoid waiting.

Based on a template with reasonable execution, but the cuteness doesn't make it a keeper. If you haven't discovered games based on this template then you might enjoy it. Advertised in another app as something it's not - the interactive battles are there but can't be repeated and fade into the background while you try to keep up with the constant pressure to grow your city and fend off bloodthirsty PVP enthusiasts.

I play the game regularly, and I am now at a decent level. Enough to compete and do my bit within the alliance I am in. The game is decent, and I enjoy playing it. But there are a few things that can be improved, for example I bet I get a response quicker here than I do for an issue flagged up on the game. The customer service is shockingly slow. I saved up to purchase VIP with my gems to quicken up my building speed, but the 30% seems to have no effect at all. I could go on.

Might as well be fake ad... The ad gameplay is about 0.001% of what's in the game the rest of the game is the usual pay to win base build. To the dev you make enough from the players why not just make the game in the add as a separate game? And for those that don't know to get anywhere in this sort of game you'll need to spend well over $1000 a month but you will get your own customer rep and some nice discounts.

Was enjoying the game, spent money, and now can't log back in. I'm still getting notifications with updates regarding my base, but the system will not log me in. I have been trying to log in since 8 pm yesterday. Especially when I get a notification, I am being attacked and can't even shield! Terrible! Waste of time and money. WTO love you guys!

ABSOLUTELY AVOID! IT'S A WASTES OF YOUR TIME! Silly me to believe the advert on YouTube! It is a building game, where to be able to shoot zombies you must build, and build is so sloooooow. To make it faster you can PAY. I played this for 5 days for free and seen the most of the people at lvl.10, and a lot of abandoned villages, because if you do not invest real money you don't really go anywhere and it becomes boring as all the similar games. Just play something else.

Constant tracking blocks ‐over a 1000 a day. Can't access free resources video as it doesn't recognise I'm online - yet I can play pvp.... go figure. Ads get too much ‐ loads of them per session ( even though im "offline"?!). Shame as it's a simple idea and great fun to actually play. Just so much hassle makes it so deleteable. Lots of in-game adverts but there is a premium if you want to pay to have them removed.Not cheap though.

The same as all the others. it just takes a bit longer to get there. You play a few easy enough missions, then you need to start with the whole base/town building BS, with little "tasks" that take a bit longer to complete each time. Basically, the complete opposite to the advertisement. Cheers for wasting my time... again.

Avoid at all costs. It is NOTHING like how it is advertised. I honestly don't know how they get away with such false advertising. It's a base building game where if you're f2p, you will NEVER compete with the big boys who spend THOUSANDS (not an exaggeration) on the game and still aren't close to the top. A guy was recently trying to sell an account he'd spent £15,000 on, and he wasn't a top player. Do yourself a favour and walk away. I'm close to 1 year in and stuck on a sunk cost fallacy.

This is not at all the puzzle and zombie-dodging game it's advertised to be. There are a small number of puzzle levels and then the entire game becomes about trying to grind and level up troops and infrastructure in ways that require you to be constantly active throughout the day or pay lots of money to keep up. A total waste of my time.

It's fun but has issues! Happy to take your money if you wish to spend. When you have issues, don't expect a quick response or the issue resolved easily. Although the experience may differ for many, I was unable to gain access for around 3 hours even though I had an Internet connection and no issues on my end. Shame as it ruined the whole experience...

This is an impalanced game mainly focused on forcing you to constantly pay money to enjoy it, way more than it is worth. I am confused as to how this game achieved this overall high rating. This game is mainly about having fun for 10 minutes of gameplay followed by constant micro transactions of paying £££$$$ in order to progress. The UI is extremely busy and confusing with multiple adverts and pop-ups.

Terrible game. I kept getting ads for this game which you can't skip (I don't mind ads in free games if it doesn't pause YouTube or music) but the demo game is fixed. Even when you keep shooting the boss with a grenade launcher his health never goes beneath 53%. Lots of other bad reviews on here of the game itself so will be deleting it. I only downloaded it so I could leave a review about how invasive and pointless the demo game in the ad is.

The advert doesn't reflect the game. It's one of those games where you have to constantly build build build and make in app purchases to get anywhere. AVOID. In response to the message they've sent here, I double down on my review. I'd add that many of the players I came across are a little demented and take the game WAY too seriously. Some even asked why I wasn't spending money!

Neither a simple shoot em up nor a strategy game. Based on ads I was expecting only a series of zombie waves; they happen but mixed in with base building, collecting resources, missions etc. However that side of the game was too prescribed to be a strategy game, and frankly did not seem to make any real difference to the outcome to the battles. Not what I was looking for but I can see that it might be enjoyable to others.

It is always a green flag for game to advertise the 1% of the gameplay and not the actual game itself. It's a bit like a little secret, where if the actual gameplay was advertised you wouldn't have nearly as many downloads. I really hope one of these days Google cracks down on this and reflects the actual main component of the game not the bonus side. Read the reviews before you download!

Ahh, man, click bait nonsense. Nothing as advertised. Actually, it looks fun in adverts but get into it, and it's just not great at all, sorry. Weird boring nothingness. Just move side-to-side automatically shoots. Boring. Probably good for 3 to 5 yr olds. Play a few games then requires you to do a load of base building. No good at all sorry. Uninstalled after 10 mins.

Fun to begin with. At the start there's lots to do, it's fairly easy to progress. The advertised gameplay is a very small portion of what the game actually entails. As it goes on though, it just becomes a chore. 2 days to build structures. Levels become very hard, and you need an insane amount of resources to upgrade your characters. It's become too much of a chore for me to continue with.

No stars. This game is trash, avoid it! There's very little action or actual gaming, it's mostly just a click fest where you have to manually claim rewards and continually repeat simple tasks which have no storyline. The games are simple and repetitive, and are not the same as the ad. You will quickly find that your hero's are not powerful enough to continue fighting, leaving you stuck grinding out tasks and clicking. It's a direct clone of similarly rubbish games like Ant Colony or Evony

Safe to say I've got baited with the ad. They have a game mode which is similar to the ad but its pointless you get nothing out of it and generally boring. Game is massively p2w, p2p. They keep slapping ads in your face to buy something and you can't turn it off. Game is easy and boring, just gate locked behind pay walls. If you got big enough wallet you could speedrun thru this. It also has some optimization issues doesn't run that great on my S21. Don't waste time, there are better games out.

Whilist it does contain some gameplay that is like the ads, the main game is mostly your typical boring as hell build and battle game. Not to mention that the style is clearly trying to copy Top War which has an absymal rating right now so i dont know why they would want to be like them. They also use the same marketing ads as Top War with some no name actor they paid to say that their game is not "fake". Download only if you're curious.

Same thing as other player reviews. The game is too intense for me. All this never ending upgrades. Too much to do. It's not solo player game. You have to be in an alliance! Then of course the booster upgrades cost ££££'s . Graphics etc are good. One can be kicked out of an alliance if you haven't played for 3 days 👎👎👎. This NOT a single player game! The description of this game is incorrect.

it's nothing like the adverts. This is a strategy/base building game. It pushes you to buy diamonds and $1 micro transactions. There's notifications constantly at the top blocking you from seeing resources. There's practically no accessibility options. This game is badly designed. it's fun for maybe 10 minutes then you get bored trying to navigate your way through the impossibly bad designed UI.

This isn't a "game" but a grind simulator that will shove micro-transactions in your face on every screen with flashing colours and sound effects. The grind is ridiculous and heavily punishes you with hours of wait time for upgrades, etc. So it's pay-to-win, and if that's the kind of game you want to support, then go for it.

The ads for this do not represent the game... there is a similar mini game but its still not the same as the ads. The main issue is the extreme pay to win, small upgrades bring huge advantages and the top players are wasting literally 10's of thousands, they are in the same 'world' as you, you cannot avoid them and due to the fully automated battles with zero skill input, you have absolutely no chance to win. You win this game by uninstalling or not installing to start with.

Advertised as a scrolling run & shoot action game, but quickly changes to a very slow base building game pushing ingame purchases. Only a few of the advertised run/shoot levels are available for each base level upgrade, with no replay, or 'for fun' options. Instead you have to wait days for the build timers tick down before gaining access to the next few levels.

An extremely addictive Massively Multiplayer Online Game disguised as a casual single player game. If you are looking for a game to play in spare moments as shown in it's ads, do not install this game as it demands a lot of time! The stuff shown in the ads and screenshots on Google play is less than 1% of the game. That said, the MMO game is good, and you can enjoy for a good while free-to-play, but eventually it appears to grind to a halt and get boring if you don't want to spend big.

the initial gameplay from the advert where you multiplying your troops and getting the end goal doesn't last long before you have to start building a base. then this becomes the main game where you need to get resources to build more on your base effectively unlocking more of what drew you to play in the first place. This is a very clever well thought out game but the problem is designed to take money at every corner. You will struggle to survive unless you spend money

Absolute waste of time, bandwidth, and space. Ignore the advertisements. This does not deliver even a small percentage of what it claims. You're not playing a game. The "interactive" elements are scripted in such a way that early on you feel like you have an effect on progressing. Soon, you realise you're pretty much just watching an animation and to progress you need to purchase unlockable content to advance time to reach the next stage. garbage... absolute garbage.

So at first the game is a lot of fun you have lots of the lane fighting as advertised. The problem is it gets less and less as you progress. You quickly find yourself waiting hours for upgrades just so you can do a few fights then you need to upgrade again. The game doesnt have any ads wich is a massive win for me. It instead used time to tempt you into spending money. As from level 10 structures it starts to take a lot of hours to upgrade. There are also a few ways to get free speed ups.

The main proposal of the game it's completely different of the ads, you can play what the ads show, but it's just a mini game. another thing it's ridiculous it's players above level 20 attacking players with level 10 or lower. it's a huge different of power. If is possible to divide by groups, make more sense and fair. examples the attacks can happen just with the people with similar levels.

This game is not like the ads. At least, 98% of this game isn't. You play it for like 3 levels before you get your first hero, at which point the game becomes a dull self-playing game with the odd boost to collect. After that, it becomes a base builder. Then there's the "Frontline Breakthrough" mode. Yes, this features the gameplay that's advertised. The issue is that you get to play these 5 times a week, max. I have more to say, but I'll run out of space if I say all of that stuff.

False advertisement! Screenshots and adverts make it look like action game where u run through gates and shoot zombies. But it's a base building game where you have to wait hours or days for upgrades to finish. Yes true it has element where you run and shoot, but it's optional and you can skip it and then have to wait while things upgrade again. They added it just so they can have adverts. Don't be fooled it's not an action game it's a strategy game.

Another game that requires you to spend money. Such a shame. Throughly enjoyed this up until the point the game became unplayable. Literally goes from playing it throughout the day to now playing it once a day, and even then you can't do the battles etc as you have to upgrade things in turn, buy without paying really money for in game purchases in becomes practically impossibly to play! Would not recommend. Don't waste your time.

Was ok. Id rather a game exactly like the ads, this game looks cheap and poorly made and the physics are strange, it's badly optimised and the view distance is 4x as far as the distance your bullets randomly disappear at. The added element of building a town also just feels like a waste of time as though they're trying to make the game seem like more than what it is. Short quick time wasters don't exist anymore and I think that's a shame.

Game is really fun and not too many ads. However upon hitting level 8 you have to allow other players to invade you. I don't want to play vs other players I simply wanted a game to pass some time that I didn't have to pour money into. Now being forced to allow others who have poured money into it to ruin my experience with the game has just killed it for me. Forced PvP should have been stated so people who don't want that can avoid the game entirely.

Is the gameplay really like it says in the videos? No. It's just ANOTHER bait and switch. You DO get to play a version of the shooter shown in the adds, but MAKE NO MISTAKE. first and foremost, this is a BASE BUILDING GAME which entices you to spend real cash money, in order to get certain heroes, upgrades,etc…just like all the rest of them

I have played this game for two month and I will give an honest and experienced review. At the start, the game is well balanced. Farming is reasonable and unlocking things has good progression. It is competitive to build up your power level. After a certain while, pay2win is everything, you can't match other players unless you pay, as the heroes and progression take to long to get. A lvl up on higher levels which cost a lot gives you as much as a lvl up on the low levels, which makes 0 sense.

I'll admit I got a little hooked on this game but it soon became repetitive. Also disheartening when you realise you'll never catch up to the strong players unless you're willing to spend an absurd amount of money. Also don't be fooled by the advertising, it's a base building game where you end up waiting days for a building to upgrade.

As per usual, false advertising. The game features the swipe and shoot gameplay, but it's only a minor part. After a couple of these encounters, it's a classic "build and upgrade a base" with micro transactions, of course. You're locked in upgrading and waiting and cannot play the advertised gameplay until you "progress". Uninstalled.

do not be fooled , it's a generic war game. And a bad one. Worst customer service ever and only ever responds to high cash players. if you can't spend, this is not the game for you. If you can spend... This is not the game for you. there is a 0.0005 percent troop rush game play. but it soon runs out and you are left in a war game that in truth is very very poorly set up. The algorithms are set wrong and cash players seem to have a lucky bonus built into them.

Nothing like what is shown in the "it's totally not fake" ad. So, chalk this up as another BS. AD shows the team constantly firing at hoards, destroying barrels to increase stats. This has modifiers you walk forwards through, fire a few shots at the incoming enemy and then its a 'you lose 1:1 to however many the opposition has and continue with what's left'

As in other reviews, the game is fun the first day, then it becomes extremely boring. What's shown in the ads is a very little part of it, after a while it doesn't even need the player to run, the battles run in auto. All that's left for you is up leveling your character and buildings, which takes insane amounts of resources and time. Don't waste your time or money.

Repetitive gameplay. In for a couple months, the dynamics within the kingdom is interesting though the servers not so much. same duel event every week, waiting to do tasks for the event. then it expands to older servers. then it expands again. almost like the newer you are the harder it would be. I'd like to see more game play within the one server and different events. Marshall is just a rally on one thing, nothing strategic. If you do invest expect repetition

Despite the adverts which say 100% gameplay like the ads. The gameplay across different ads is different. Unsurprisingly the gameplay is similar to one of the old ads, however also not the gameplay in any ad I've seen. Even the ads where its claimed to be live play of the game. Which is weird because if they showed the actually game play they have a half decent game to show off. If it wasn't for the disingenuous marketing strategy it'd be a 3-4 star ftp game with the associated mechanics.

Nonsense, just give us the game where you play what is advertised? it's not rocket science, this is what people want a sliiy time waster where you collect men and guns and shoot zombies until you make the wrong move and start again! I'll actually pay for it if it's just the game that's advertised when are you going to understand that's why people click on it.....seriously

Beware of the greedy developers! My autistic son gained access to my account and made purchases totalling £150. I was able to get this refunded via Google Play. However, I then attempted to log into the game and was met with a pop-up telling me that those same refunds had put my account into a credit score negative, it is a predatory system implemented by the developers of this game. Now, my account that I've been playing on for over a year is inaccessible unless I pay them back £150.

It's an ok base builder. Your progress will be severely hampered if you don't spend. I played for a couple of days but I was really put off by the high pressure mechanics - shortly after you start, you have to complete a load of levels within 24 hours or your assistant will be blown up by a bomb. But if you don't make it on time, she's fine, so it's just lying to you to get you to play more. I don't need that dishonesty. Also, games that advertise by showing you someone playing badly... yuck.

only a bit like the adverts, the 'math puzzle' scroller is more of a mini game - not the main gameplay. this game is actually more like farmville to play. some frontline levels are really badly implemented and need updating (frontline is where the gameplay from the adverts is) - inconsistencies on every attempt: initial rate of fire, damage done with individual bullets, enemy attack range - all out of the player's control, very frustrating at times

Don't waste your time & money. It is a fun game but if you want to get anywhere you need to spend money. Good hero's can only be bought, £20 a week. Upgrading them will cost you at least £5 a week. The customer support is poor at best. Missing rewards require screenshots which you can't get.

Pay to win. Spend literally weeks of real time upgrading critical things in your base OR pay for speedups. If you don't pay enough you won't be competitive and will get ganked every time you try to face off with an enemy. Avoid if you are on a budget, I put several hundred pounds into this game over approximately 130 days and still was not competitive. You potentially can spend far FAR more than I put in. That being said, this game is pretty good but definitely addictive.

Misleading, deceptive and deceitful micro-transactions. Scam behaviour. There is an option to pay £1.99 to 'permanantly unlock the building queue' (the building queue limits you to building one 'item' at a time). You would think by paying £1.99 this would mean that the building queue is permanently unlocked, but no, there is indeed still a queue... Now the game wants £9.99 to again, 'permanently unlock building queue'. Maybe after paying several hundred pounds you receive what is implied...

Would be a nice game, but some people are very aggressive players, especially the people who spending a lot of money to speed up upgrades and gain experience ( even if they are from the same server), just keep destroying everything you have built for the past months. Also, the charts I seen this weekend, I don't want my kids to see that, very violent and bullying against the wicker players. Developers seem just interested in the income not in the safety of the players. Very disappointed...

It's pay to win. And expensive rip off pay to win at that. Initially it has balanced farming and resource collection, but it will soon change and become a hard pay wall to further your progression. Lots of "mega discounts at 3500% off!" (yes really) to draw you in and spend for very basic things such as another tech research centre, or another build queue. Detest this model of "gaming".

Offers quite a lot of different things to do, but ultimately, unless you are prepared to spend 100s on upgrade packages, you will just get repeatedly attacked by people many levels higher than you, undoing days and days of building up troops instantly. I uninstalled as it wasn't worth it and there's no chance to get to a high level.

You have to take this for what games like this are: random number generated prizes scams to mimic gambling-like reactions. This one requires to build up a set of heroes for short-lived missions and upgrade the base gradually (at some point it will take a whole day for a single buildin) to move forward. If you are not willing to pay, simply stay away and avoid the frustration altogether as it is really pricy and pointless as a f2p player.

This games adverts are literally "wow this is the actual game" I thought it looked like a fun skill based game so have it a try. It's a generic base builder/hero upgrade game with the gameplay you seeing in the ads only a miniscule part of the game. Annoying that the sales pitch for this game is we aren't doing a bait and switch...... When that is in fact what they are doing.

Advertised as an infinite runner, most of this game is based building; inevitably culminating in paying to be able to bypass time limits which stop you from actual doing the gameplay. This is not said anywhere and frankly just gets in the way of what the game is advertised as. This is clearly another permutation of the profitable dime-a-dozen base building cash grabs that clog up this app store

This game is really a scam, it costs lots of resource to upgrade hero and cities. After a while, it is getting hard to play without using ingame purchase to upgrade. I need to upgrade 5 levels for five hero’s to proceed next stage. The core of this game is you paid to win, it is not targeting gamers who enjoy zombie world adventures

Tried because it was "actually like the trailer" which was true, but the core of the game becomes based building and upgrading designed to force you into buying speed ups for money. I was happy playing in general, but I uninstalled because I was forced into the PvP mechanic without warning or notice. Don't see any reason to play again.

Base building game with what is shown in the advertisment as a mini game in the game. Carbon copy with very little unique differences of basically 10 or more titles they are all the same. Dont play the game unless you want to spend the majority of your time waiting for cooldown timers while being bombarded with micro transactions.

Dreadful. False advertising for a start, the ads you see with the power ups to collect to defeat the horde are barely in the game at all. It's a base builder game with small mini games that simulate the ads. The game is ad riddled and full of predatory monitization. I may not have played much but it was more than enough.

Looks nothing like the ads Has some zombie/monster element to the game and not once has any of the advertised videos featured in my gameplay. Time gates restrict play unless you're willing to pay. I've only made one purchase on a whim after 20hrs playing the game to allow for two construction projects go ahead for £4.99 but te jump after us egregious IMHO. Nice to play for a few hours but buyer beware

Balancing is all off. You get way too much resources. I've got like 200 million of each and haven't upgraded any of my mines, just no point. Upgrading your hero's quickly becomes an absolute chores, as there's no many ways to get hero exp and they ways you do give you so little. It's a shame as it's a really good game but needs to be redone and fixed before I keep playing

to start with it was excellent fun, met great people and enjoyed playing.... but then it becomes apparent that there are things you can't get without spending real hard cash!! (IMO everything should be available if you save resources like diamond and gold etc) but even then it takes soooooo long in time gather this the people who 💦💦 loads of money are always going to be better. have now deleted the game through pure frustration that you can't keep up at high levels without spending 💰

It's exactly the same mobile game you think it is. Build a base that gives you timers you can spend gems to speed up, join an alliance that gives you certain benefits, buy heroes with micro transactions, level up everything with more micro transactions, and above all spam you with notifications and tiny rewards to keep you full of dopamine until you make your first in game purchase. Not worth bothering with, you've played it before and this one doesn't do anything the others didn't

The ads that say this isn't the fake game from other ads? Just another scam. The game in the ads is barely featured in this app, and it's locked behind a progression system, which is - you guessed it... ANOTHER GATCHA PAYWALL BASE BUILDING GAME. Exactly the same, greedy base builder as every other game on the market. Don't bother.

Great game except it really pushes you to spend in order to keep up or get special weapons... Not like the ad either. Seen so many top players give up and stop playing simply because the game is draining too much money from the individual... Great game if it wasn't so heavy on pay2win or if you can stop yourself from spending but you won't stand a chance against the players who do spend... So my advice is, avoid this game if you have a life or family priorities..!

Data farming 101. I opened the apps saw that of you click play you automatically agree to their terms of service and user agreement, so I briefly read them and the small print. Long and short of it is the collect your data, your social media data, they actively use trackers to search your device while you play and will use all the info themselves and with third parties. Uninstalled it. Gaming is Inna sorry state.

Very much NOT as advertised, despite this games ads specifically trying to push the message that the game is exactly like the ads. In reality it's very poorly made, feels like some Chinese corporation shovelware, very hollow and soulless, and you'll end up spending much more time playing another Clash of Clans base builder type game than actually having any kind of fun gameplay.

This is one of your bog standard level up, collect resources base games and collect hero fragments to make your hero's and grind with the need for constantly more resources with the shooting on rails ads you've seen on YouTube tacked on as a after thought. This is here game is a money sink, somewhat predatory with its "offers" , isn't much new in this game compared to others like it. Save your money, buy a 6 pack of beer.

It's nearly how they advertise, but not quite. The play is static and the enemies and weapons come to you. It's a very simple game which can be fun for a small amount of time, but will quickly become repetitive, I think the developers know this so have done a half-decent job of it, it's not exactly a bad game, just way overhyped because of the amount of ads that spawned.

Incredibly boring, don't understand the high rating. The actual gameplay that you see on trailers and screenshots is far too easy, short, and uneventful, but that only makes up about 1/4 of the game, the rest of it is opening bonus items and watching tedious speeches by characters you don't care about.

Boring. The battles are very easy and over very quickly and then there are bases to build and crops to grow, mouths to feed. i was just after the game whose ad pops up the entire time playing other games but instead i was killing little zombies, which is better than random soldiers, but all very tiny and a lot of reading tiny text in between and graphics clearly designed by a straight man for straight men! not enough battles either and looks like it will take longer and longer in between.

The game is OK although the battles stop later on and you have to mainly play on auto which is annoying. The worst part of the game is the spam in the chats. You can't block and there are multiple chats that spam all day long so you're constantly getting useless notifications in the app. Please develop this to be able to filter out the nonsense chatter!

Just another pay to win game. The basic framework of the game has been laid out, but anything more is lacking. After that, it appears all the effort went into trying to milk players of as much money through micro transactions as possible. It's a shame because this game concept isn't bad — the execution is.

Decent game with the "alley run" style combat as advertised, as well as some base building. Only issue is that if you don't want to spend any real money on it it gets very slow after a few days. My combat units aren't strong enough to defeat any more enemies until my HQ has upgraded, which is going to take 6 hours apparently. I'm essentially stuck until that's done.

The game has more battle passes than anyother game I know I don't mind spending the odd couple of pounds on a game at times especially F2P but this one just takes it too far And if its not the multiple £20 battle passes its the 99.99 packs I spent £10 on fallout shelter and I still haven't opened all the lunch boxes because I got an overload with items and resources I spend £10 here it's not enough to level up one characters star I get that it's different but you can see the value difference

Would rater better if not for greedy devs. Resources go missing, game lag, poor communication. Pay to play is the name of this game. Enjoyable, yes, but don't plan to make any real headway unless you are prepared to spend hundreds of pounds a day. There are players who have spent over £10,000 and are still baby players in comparison to 'whales', so unless you have a lot of money, it's most likely not the game for you. Developers are also very bad at responding to issues.

The advertised game play is a tiny proportion of the actual game. You'll invest a significant amount of time into the game initially only to be repaid by effectively hitting a wall that can really only be overcome by buying packs or "subscription to paid packs" you could just wait patiently for 2 days to upgrade basic items or heal your damaged troops that have been decimated by people who have bought their way into the game. Is it worth it? In my opinion no.

A game for the brainless people, literally everything you do is basically automatic, your decisions are limited to infinitely upgrading buildings and your heroes, it takes hours, to speed something up you actually have to use real money. You have to pay for everything everywhere... To begin with, I calculated that it would cost me over 90 pounds to make progress without waiting forever. £90, for stupid clicking and watching you gain one step forward.. As I said for brainless.. To pay and to play

The survival waves are fine, but I don't like the building and town elements between them. If this was better balanced with the survival waves, it would be better. I just want a game I can pick up, enjoy, and not need to spend extra thought or time upgrading buildings to proceed.

The game is OK, the developer not so much. I purchased an in game pack which indicated would give some tokens to unlock a particular characters special weapon. It did not, so I asked Google for a refund. The developer has now locked me out of the game and is asking for me to repay the refund. Really nasty behavior from the developer, especially given the amount of money I have sunk into their game. Be warned.

If your designated in-game server doesn't feature strict rules on non-internal attacks, don't waste weeks of your life playing and building your location up, only to find someone has destroyed all your planning and efforts whilst you were not online by attacking without warning. The game has designated wars between servers, which you can plan for, but attacks outside of this environment are just a joke to the gaming experience. I uninstalled it after a few weeks for this very reason.

Started off enjoyable but soon turns into a game of whoever spends more. You get put into a server which are managed by certain players who end up determining what you can and can't do so, these players end up dictating who can do well and who can't. Great for developers as these players probably spend 1000s but for leisurely players who just looking for a little fun not very enjoyable.

The ad I saw specifically stated that this game was only a side-to-side. Verbally, not just game footage. They addressed the issue by saying footage in ads only shows one aspect, which would be fine if the ad didn't state very clearly that this was the only type of gameplay in the game. They chose to ignore the fact that the ad lied outright instead, opting to explain the way the game is played, as if I hadn't played to reach my conclusion. Too much chicanery and lies.

Deceiving icon as the calculation battle is only available in a special stage, which is heavily level capped(You can play 4 stages with one level etc). The general battles are brain-dead avoid red things stages. Survivor designs are duplicate of the same 5-6 designs multiple times. Building time increase exponentially with little benefit. The game aims to be gacha, farming, and collaborative, but the execution is not attracting me. I would advise to save wasting time by avoiding it altogether.

Fun for 5 minutes till you reach the base, then quickly becomes a pay to progress game unless you spend hours waiting for your buildings and upgrades to complete, even then it gives you minimal reward for progression. It's everything that's wrong with mobile gaming, the predatory nature particular in this current economic climate is genuinely sickening, would zero star it if I could. Avoid.

This is a very good game if your into strategy games, it is true that spending money helps progress but so does being active. I give the game 1 star because the game has many server and I have seen many instances of bullying and people gang up on people, last war will simply tell you to make a new account rather than give the option to apply to move to another server so players don't have to lose all there progress. This is very sad that the developers do not care for their customers gaming exp.

This game is VERY DISAPPOINTING. The ADVERT DOES NOT MATCH THE GAME PLAY. The time elements of the game is confusing and terrible. It uses an exponential scale, the first 5 levels are seconds then minutes. Beyond level 7 you need to wait over an hour, unless you use/purchase poorly priced boosters and/or be extorted. DO NOT DOWNLOAD, if you do... DONT PAY FOR ANYTHING. Value is based on nothing tangible. Update: Developers comment/reply is vague "MAY EXPERIENCE" and also untrue

My main task "clear block 24" has been bugged for a few days. I've updated and reinstalled. Halting progress in the game. Update: @FirstFun Studio that is correct. It is my only main task that shows up, I've cleared that block and many others after it (no reward for these), in fact I've placed objects within that area in the map. No new tasks have appeared for the last week of me playing and progressing the game.

Game needs to decide what it wants to be. It's a side scrolling shooter... and a base building game... and a gacha game? Quite clearly a developer that's trying to make easy money. Just play something else. Be prepared to expect a blanket 'dear commander' response to any feedback you might give.

Disappointing. very quickly became overloaded with stuff in a base that too attention seeking, overloading, and appeared to have no purpose. The main game appeared also be an illusion, and overwhelming. just couldn't see what was going on. My play makes no difference. I just couldn't see what was on. pointless

It's a fun game and I like the team/social aspect but it's also the definition of pay to win. Money is much more important than skill and the pricing levels are utterly predatory. It seems a seriously immoral business running the game as their model is to get all of it's customers addicted and then charge ridiculous sums. Many people on my server are spending hundreds of £ most days and the business is making an absolute killing. I wish I had never started but I've fallen into their trap...

Such a disappointment☹️ after all those adverts screaming about them showing real gameplay unlike all the other games, although I suppose if you're screaming that you're hiding something else... and that's the fact that you get 6 levels of the advertised game and then it starts an Evony style base building game, you know the type where you have to keep clicking again and again and it slowly builds a bit over time putting you on that hopeless grind that they hope you'll pay to speed things up🤮🤮

Like getting absolutely destroyed by vastly higher level players day in day out? Like spending all your time healing your team and repairing your base only to do it all again and again and again? Like getting the fun and enjoyment of the game sucked out of you? Then this is the game for you. If however you are like me then avoid this game, why the dev's of these types of games don't limit the level difference of players you can attack I don't know, but then again how will they make money.

Tried to give it a fair shot. Would have loved more gameplay and less base building strategy. Not a fan of the AI art character models either, it's a very telling style. Too many overpriced passes, a £25 battlepass AND £10 reward tracks etc plus a million one off pay to play packages. It feels like this game is trying to push the boundary on micro transactions.

Another game that lies, even their adverts call out the other fake games for the same thing they are doing, advertised all over as a war game between a red and blue faction, not a thing, it's you vs zombies and ones that look like they were stolen from PvZ, troops also don't fire straight ahead most of the time meaning alot of the challenges are purely RNG based, then there's the impossibility of breaking anything when you have items with triple digits straight away, shame on you Anthony Starr.

Don't be fooled, yet another base building game, which is fine but why mislead users into thinking it's something completely different. I got sucked in and for a month or 2 it's not too bad, loads to do, but then, like most of these types of games, you need to invest far too much time and effort into speaking with complete strangers, using a so so translate feature, ensuring that you shield all the time and attack everything that moves.. .

The app inaccurately describes its in-app purchases. When challenging the wording and suggesting alternative, more accurate descriptions, the customer services are aggressive and threaten to lock you out of your account if you request a refund. They have no method to refund, so Google Play has to decide if a refund is warrantied. Google play provided a refund, and so Last War have locked me out of my account. Responding to below: your chat bot won't connect me to an agent!!

I normally don't leave reviews. I've been playing this game for a yr n half n still learning. It's very technical, n the developers are always adding something new. It's not the type of game you play for a couple of months n get bored with. Would highly recommend checking it out. The support team, n players, are always willing to help. Great way to have fun!

It's been 2 years I've enjoyed playing with many alliances, The biggest disadvantage is it's too expensive to buy something you need to gear up it would be better if the prices would go like ₹50 or ₹100 rather than 10K to 40K it's just a game and could be user friendly. I never invested coz of too much pricing. And my team mates in the alliances stopped playing after an year and few left after 2 years.. Their accounts were powerful and upgraded but they left it's waste of investment now.

Easy at first to get you hooked. As any other massive multi-player game, you will 100% have to pay to win. You will be competing against players who spend thousands. Don't get caught in the trap. Your small purchases add up fast. You will progressively spend more until your dropping hundreds of dollars at a time.

I played for over 500 days. I literally downloaded it to shoot barrels then turns into another rubbish alliance game that incentivises you to spend money or be irrelevant. each season it becomes more apparent the game is only designed for people who are spending money. if you dont spend money just dont play. when I say spend money im talking hundreds per day. stay away.

save your time and money you can't get anything done playing for free customer support sucks even for paying customers, I accidentally requested a refund which took months to process and after it was done I was put on restricted gameplay, now I can't even log in because I have to pay the amount they refunded to be able to log in. seems like they only respond to reviews that aren't critical of their business model.

The community in the game is great once you find a good alliance, that's my only positive. This is the biggest money grabbing game I've ever come across. If you do not spend money you will quickly fall behind those that do, and with it being centred around power you'll quickly find yourself at the mercy of the spenders and they will dictate how the rest of your experience in that game goes.

There was an episode of South Park called 'Freemium' that describes this game perfectly. It cud have been a great game but unfortunately the greed that the creators of such games have is enormous. If u buy a game on Xbox u can enjoy that game without having to spend ₹1000s more just to play it properly. These types of games want u to spend a ton of money to enjoy them properly. To give u an idea just at level 15 or so out of 50+ i suppose, you have to wait for 20+ hrs to level up.
good game to spend time when you have to work

The main part of the shooting is great but the constant building of your base gets annoying and repetitive it should be a simple base and quick upgrade it's far too much going on and takes too long. The main point should be the main game not constantly going back and building your base. Uninstalled it.

Fun but....... The game is fun to play, specially at first because the upgrades are quick and don't take too long. The problem is in the later stages the upgrades turn from a few hours to days of waiting time. It is a mobile game after all so pay to progress quickly will incentivize some. If you are not willing to wait w/o paying, look else where, otherwise give me $$$$. And getting those hero tickets have become hard to get.

so here is my honest take on this game. it starts off kinda fun but challenging as you can get blasted quite easily by larger players. as I played i started to get bored. it takes entirely way to long to build things unless you have deep pockets to blow on buying upgrades or join a large alliance to gain speed ups and unfortunately joining a large alliance is like a job you don't like. People telling you what to do. and you don't get paid to deal with it. I wouldn't recommend this game👎👎👎

Pay to play and what you purchase can be stolen an unlimited amount of times by higher level players. So you can pay for resources needed to build and then other users can steal it as a many times as they want. Lost over a million coins, iron and farming to one person who raided my bases 8 times in a row.

Surprisingly enough, there were no ads in the first 10 minutes or so that I played the game. But rest assured, they have to gain revenue somehow. more importantly, there is virtually no skill at all needed in this game, it's very clearly a mindless a click and scroll game. That's fine if that keeps your attention, but not for me.
Game not like ads. Player controlled. Creator won't abolish Nap 10. I quit.

another stupid base building game. don't waste your time. edit: here's your feedback. make the game actually match the ads. I was interested in the game based on the ad. then, I played one round and it immediately went to one of the stereotypical base building games. hard pass, immediate uninstall.

This is not a simple scrolling skill game, unfortunately. It is a time-dependent, base building game that uses the scrolling gates as a gimmick. There isn't any real strategy or skill involved. if you've invested enough time (or money) into building up your bases, the levels are winnable, otherwise they are not.

Ad Scamming POS. After getting pulled out of my original game to watch an ad and forced to go to Google Play, I downloaded the game just to leave a negative review. Whose fault is it? Don't care. The game is decent. It's really close to how the ad is, with additional missions or progression, but for pulling me out of my game negative review.

This game is designed to be deceptively deterministic. You reach the point at which absolute optimal performance results in loss 100% of the time. Then you upgrade your "heroes" and suddenly win very easily. This is a hero-based autobattler with SUPERCELL/Clash based predetermined victories heavily dependent on how much money you spend. I would have given three stars for including a game mode that shows what is in the ad: but it lies to you about beating XX% of players. Made up number.

Schedule is way too intense, it makes it stressful. Having to fight for your Capitol, do SvS, AND VS, all within 24 hours?? It's just way too much. Not to mention: This game, other than being a micro transaction suck hole, is STINGY. The amount of value you get for what you're paying out, just such sucks. At later stages you could drop a $1,000.00 And not even be able to level yourself up once. It's ridiculous! The package value needs to grow with player.

Very good, detailed, strategic game and totally able to play for free but it's very much a 'pay to win' game that many seem to do, leaving free to play players feeling left behind. Still enjoyable if you ignore what others are doing though.

The game overall is not like the ads. It's a multi-player base building and alliance game, where if you don't build and get in an alliance quickly and establish server rules and peace between objectives, your server will fail. The game is pretty generous with rewards so free to play is possible, but not sustainable if you want to be in a top 3 alliance. Top players will spend literally thousands on this game. If you know how to play, it's not hard to advance with f2p. But power will be lacking

It's a money grab game don't install. The in game events let you win just by buying packs so it's 100% pay to win. There are apparently people who spend 100s of dollars on this game, and you will never, ever beat them. You will always lose unless you spend all your money. Edit: And their development can't even be bothered to give decent responses. Trash game. They like Koreans better and charge them less. Discrimination.

Pay to win is very very expensive for a minimal amount of gain and resources and is setup to drain players pocket weekly if not daily. Upgrade of resource building ita hourly output doesn't adjust to how much a building cost, the hourly output should be proportional to the level of building cost as level goes higher, this is just another con to take player money.

Very pay to win game. There is only one UR (ultra rare) hero you can get from the "free" banner that's always available and can grind for the tickets to roll. All the other UR heroes are either locked from a one week battle pass type event which you need to pay for like $20 each for the premium(yes, ONE hero from a single pass) or locked from another one week gacha event which is probably the most f2p friendly option. Gameplay is decent but the devs are too greedy with this game.

This game feels like a scam. I spent more than I should have, and when I had an issue with a promotional item where the amount I would receive was unclear, the support team refused to resolve it. Save yourself the frustration and skip this game.

fun for the first 10 min despite the non stop ads. then it's boring its all about building walls and upgrading buildings. waiting forever or paying to build irrelevant things or you can't play the part you downloaded the game for. it's repetitive & boring. also takes like 1.5 GB of space on my phone. idk for what since the graphics are lame. something weird there. what are the developers doing on my phone?
